doc: The eval harness's suites (tools/tandem_eval.py, OPS-43). Paths with ~ are on the machine that runs opencode; relative ones are from this folder. `rewrite`: strings in the prompt (and in `rewrite_files` of the run folder) that become the run folder. `gates.list[].args`: a regex on the checker call's input; `unless_failing`: the gate passes when that reading is not among the failing ones; `final`: the harness's own `final_check` decides. `pristine`: files hashed before the night and after every run (`run:` = the run folder's copy against the template's). `final_shot`: the shot the final check reads, as patterns under the run folder tried in order and matched without case (the newest file of the first pattern with a match; `*.check.png` heatmaps never count); in `final_check`, `{shot}` is that shot and `{dir}` the run folder. `clock`: the wall-clock deadline the prompt names ("until 07:15"), replaced in each run's prompt, continuation and `rewrite_files` by the run's own (its start plus `timeout_min`, local HH:MM).

suites.title: minicalc (short coding)
suites.prompt: Read SPEC.md and build minicalc exactly as specified, with tests. check.py is the acceptance checker: run python3 check.py and iterate until it prints RESULT: PASS and python3 -m unittest discover -s tests passes. Never edit check.py or SPEC.md, and do not run git. Do not ask questions; when unsure, take the simpler reading of the spec.
suites.continue: Continue. Run python3 check.py, fix the first failing group, and run it again until it prints RESULT: PASS.

suites.title: spiral portrait
replace: - git init. Commit after every stage that passes its gate, with the `RESULT:` line in the message.
suites.continue: Continue the spiral portrait. Take the next stage whose gate is not met, run its gate, and keep going until Stage 4 passes. Do not ask questions.
suites.note: Stage 2 (the path) has no checker gate and is not counted. Stage 4's gate is the harness's own check of the last stage's shot (shots/s4-animated.png, the prompt's name; never s4-mid.png, a frame taken mid-animation).

suites.title: photo to 3D
suites.note: The full gate is the harness's own check of the last stage's shot: final.png when the model wrote one, else the highest of S7, S6, S5 (each gated with --stage full), in either case; hourly shots never count.

suites.title: pagoda seasons
suites.why_disabled: ~/demos/pagoda-seasons holds night 2's changes (js/seasons/, main.js, core/season.js); point `template` at a clean copy of the night-1 island first
